methodology.temperatureError: Observed official-station temperature minus the midpoint of the issued range.
methodology.precipitation: Brier score for occurrence at either official station in the region; lower is better.
methodology.rangeCalibration: Coverage is the percentage of official-station observations inside the issued range.
methodology.models: Per-model scores require modelBenchmarks captured at issuance; station-tagged benchmarks use that exact official station and untagged legacy benchmarks use the regional official-station mean. Models are never reconstructed after the fact.
methodology.weatherRegime: Explicit day-level weatherRegime is required for new issues; legacy issues use documented text inference.
methodology.compositeAccuracy: A category-balanced percentage covering temperature, precipitation, wind, fog/visibility, cloud cover, thunder, hazards, event timing, weather-regime narrative, official-alert documentation and confidence calibration. Each available category receives equal weight; missing categories are disclosed rather than counted as failures.

componentRules.temperature: Binary credit for each official-station high and low inside the issued range.
componentRules.precipitation: Probability accuracy is 1 minus the Brier score for regional occurrence.
componentRules.wind: Full credit inside the issued sustained/gust range, tapering to zero over 10 mph for sustained wind and 15 mph for gusts.
componentRules.visibilityFog: Brier-style probability accuracy for fog or sub-mile visibility.
componentRules.cloudCover: Ordinal agreement across clear, mostly clear, partly cloudy, mostly cloudy and overcast categories.
componentRules.thunder: Brier-style probability accuracy for an official-station thunder report.
componentRules.hazards: Mean Brier-style probability accuracy for observable fog, wind, thunder, heavy-rain, heat and freeze hazards against explicit measurable thresholds; legacy forecasts use Jaccard agreement.
componentRules.eventTiming: Brier-style accuracy for timestamped event windows with an issued tolerance; legacy forecasts use morning/afternoon/evening/night overlap.
componentRules.weatherRegimeNarrative: Deterministic outcome rule appropriate to the issued weatherRegime.
componentRules.officialAlertHandling: Checks that the issuance-time alert status is explicit and backed by a timestamped official source.
componentRules.confidenceCalibration: One minus squared error between issued confidence and realized component accuracy.

allCategoryAccuracy.weighting: Each scored category receives equal weight; missing categories are excluded and disclosed through categoryCoverage.

models.availability: Station-tagged model benchmarks are scored against that official station; legacy untagged benchmarks retain regional official-observation means.

biasCorrection.signConvention: Positive means observations were warmer than the issued midpoint and future guidance may be adjusted upward.

temperatureRanges.instruction: Use at least the recommended empirical width unless current ensemble spread or a documented meteorological reason supports a wider range. A narrower range requires an explicit override reason.

modelWeighting.instruction: Use regime-specific weights when available. When samples are insufficient, document the operational blend and retain at least two independent model families.

intermediateUpdates.instruction: Issue an intermediate candidate only when an observation or guidance change crosses a threshold; a new official alert always triggers review.
